name: Performance Regressions
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      rust: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.rust }}
      tauri-plugins: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.tauri-plugins }}
      branch: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for changes
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v2
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/**'
            rust:
              - '.cargo/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'crates/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/**'
              - 'Cargo.toml'
              - 'Cargo.lock'
            tauri-plugins:
              - 'Cargo.lock'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'

      - name: Output branch name
        id: branch
        run: |
          echo "branch=${{ env.BRANCH_NAME }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  performance-regression-test:
    name: Performance Regression Test
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          cache: true

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-js

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pnpm install
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm install

      - name: Build project
        run: |
          pnpm build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm tauri build --verbose

      - name: Run performance tests
        run: |
          pnpm test:benchmark

      - name: Upload benchmark results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: |
            **/benchmark-results.json
            **/performance-report.txt
          retention-days: 30

  keyboard-captions-performance:
    name: Keyboard and Captions Tracks Performance
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.rust == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          cache: true

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-js

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pnpm install
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm install

      - name: Build project
        run: |
          pnpm build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm tauri build --verbose

      - name: Run keyboard and captions tests
        run: |
          pnpm test:suite:recording
          pnpm test:suite:playback

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: keyboard-captions-test-results
          path: |
            **/keyboard-captions-test-results.json
            **/test-report.txt
          retention-days: 30

  performance-analysis:
    name: Performance Analysis
    needs: [performance-regression-test, keyboard-captions-performance]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download benchmark results
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: ./artifacts

      - name: Download test results
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: keyboard-captions-test-results
          path: ./artifacts

      - name: Analyze performance regressions
        run: |
          echo "Analyzing performance regressions..."
          # Add performance analysis logic here
          echo "Performance analysis complete"

      - name: Generate performance report
        run: |
          echo "Generating performance report..."
          # Add report generation logic here
          echo "Performance report generated"

      - name: Upload performance report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: performance-report
          path: |
            **/performance-report.txt
            **/regression-summary.md
          retention-days: 30
